title: Honeyed Kenyan Maize Wrap
description: Malty, cheese-pull Kenyan wrap steamed on lotus leaves, egg‑free and romantic.
instructions: In a bowl mix maize flour, salt, and yeast.
Add warm water, honey, and rapeseed oil to the dry mix and stir until a sticky dough forms.
Knead the dough on a lightly floured surface for 3 minutes until smooth.
Let the dough rise in a warm spot covered with a damp cloth for 25 minutes until doubled.
Soak lotus leaves in warm water until pliable, then pat dry.
Divide the dough into 4 equal portions and roll each into a thin circle about 6 inches in diameter.
Place a spoonful of shredded cheese on each dough circle, then fold the edges over to form a wrap.
Arrange the wraps on a steamer basket lined with lotus leaves and steam over simmering water for 8 minutes.
Serve the warm wraps drizzled with a bit of honey and enjoy.
